Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Lattice-Patterned Rug, 5' x 8', Beige and Cream
A beige and cream geometric pattern creates a rug that is textured enough to create an accent anywhere it is placed but subtle enough to work with almost any room’s color scheme. The soft pile adds a warm and stylish cushioning to your bare floors. 5'W x 8'L Front: 91% cotton, 8% polyester, 1% viscose; backing: 100% cotton Modern geometric design in classic neutrals The medium pile makes this rug ideal for moderate traffic areas. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
